'''Breckon''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|General]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was revealed as a traitor and killed in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]] while fleeing to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:KGB" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCivilian.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of General Breckon]]
Breckon appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KGB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> General Breckon was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:KGB" />
